🚨
Critical: Month-to-Month Risk
42.7% of month-to-month customers churn, vs only 2.8% on two-year contracts. Contract upgrades are the single biggest lever.
📡
Fiber Optic Dissatisfaction
Fiber optic customers churn at 41.9% — more than 5× those with no internet (7.4%). Investigate pricing and service quality issues.
⏱️
First-Year Vulnerability
47.7% of customers in their first 12 months churn. Onboarding programs and early engagement are crucial retention tools.
